title: Note: Dictate becomes an extension with a contextual destination

text: Heard, and it is the right shape: Dictate moves to ext/ (it has dependencies — whisper now, maybe cloud later), gets real docs, a working level on the mic, and no destination button — where you are decides where words go: on the AI page, an assistant tab where you click the mic, talk, and see the names and cards appear. Briefed as dictate-extension; starts the moment the bench minion lands its mic picker.
